title: Borland pulls AARO reports on baiting craft and taking them down
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Borland pulls AARO reports on baiting craft and taking them down, about 2023 at government databases (DTRA access), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then I can begin to pull reports and briefings from Arrow and reports about baiting craft uh and how to take them down,

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who says he worked inside the US government, says that in 2023, through access tied to the Defense Threat Reduction Agency, a Pentagon agency that deals with weapons threats, he could search government files. He says he began pulling reports and briefings from AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into unexplained objects in the sky, about how to lure in unknown craft and bring them down. If true, it would mean the government has plans for catching such craft.
